passages.text:
Re: Panel Discussion
[contact omitted] Joshua Machleder Wednesday, May 12, 2021 at 3:10:08PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Mike Bradow
Cc: [contact omitted] Nicole Goodrich
Hey Mike -- we will definitely want to follow up with you from our group conversation earlier. We've taken a little bit of time
because I was on leave and because we wrote up a summary of our discussion that we're circulating and would like to
share with you about possible more formal collaboration between USAID and Fb.
Best, Josh
On Wed, May 12, 2021 at 12:02 PM Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Nicole,
Thanks for following up on this. Totally understandable that you all want to keep the session internal. Perhaps you
could use that as an opportunity to crowdsource any questions/issues that the group would like to explore with FB
in a future conversation? We're open to doing something in June/July, whenever is timely for you all.
Mike
From: Nicole Goodrich <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, May 5, 2021 10:27 AM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Panel Discussion
Ні Mike,
Hope your morning is going well.
Thanks for your willingness to speak during the disinformation session at the Asia Pacific DRG conference. The
organizing team decided to keep the session focused on internal USAID work like Josh's disinfo primer and disinfo
projects in the Philippines and Indonesia.
I do not think you are crushed with this news, but it would be great to see you on a computer screen again. So, a
question. Would you be interested in speaking separately to colleagues across Asia and the Pacific (and Asia
Bureau Washington) about Facebook and disinfo? We could plan a meeting for early June if that would work for you
(and you couldinclude your colleague in Singapore). Really anytime this summer would be great - June or July.
If you are interested, let me know your availability.
Thanks again, Mike.
Sincerely,
Nicole
Sincerely,
Nicole
On Tue, May 4, 2021 at 6:44 PM Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Sounds good - thanks!
From: Nicole Goodrich <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, May 3, 2021 11:50 AM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>

Cc: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Panel Discussion
Ні Mike,
Hope you had a pleasant weekend, and I am sorry I did not get back to you sooner.
The time is pretty locked in (at least for the conference session on disinformation). That being said, I am talking with
Laura tonight and the weekly conference planning meeting is on Tues. night. Letme getback to you by Wed.
morning. I hope that is okay, but of course we would always be happy to have you join us!
Sincerely,
Nicole
On Fri, Apr 30, 2021 at 12:23 PM Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh & Nicole,
Just checking to see if you all are considering other time slots for this panel or if the time is locked. My
colleague Alice isn't available at that time, but may be able to do it (particularly if earlier). Otherwise you'll be
stuck with me
Thanks!
Mike
From: Nicole Goodrich <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, April 29, 2021 10:07 AM
To: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>; Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Panel Discussion
A big thanks, Mike! Appreciate you checking with your colleague and letting us know.
Hope you are taking good care, and the family is well.
Sincerely,
Nicole
On Thu, Apr 29, 2021 at 9:26 AM Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey Mike -- thanks so much for your response and agreeing to join us, or have someone in your place
participate!
Best, Josh
On Thu, Apr 29, 2021 at 8:59 AM Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh & Nicole!
Great to hear from you - I can't believe DRG conference season is already here!
I should be able to do this, though I'm wondering if my colleague Alice would be a better fit. She
covers misinfo/disinfo out of Singapore, and the time is fairly reasonable for her to join virtually.
If it's okay with you, l'll reach out and gauge her interest.
Mike
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, April 28, 2021 12:38 PM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Nicole Goodrich <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Panel Discussion

Hi Mike,
I hope you're doing well! I had a quick question/request. Our colleagues at Asia Bureau are planning a virtual
Asia Pacific DRG virtual conference, May 18-20.
They were asking if you and l and another guest (TBD) would participate on a panel about disinformation for
Wednesday, May 18 at about 7:30am EST. Would you be willing and able. I'd be happy to discuss parameters
for the discussion as soon as I'm back in the office (I'm on leave until the 8th). Just wanted to put in the
request and, if you are able to join the panel, mark our calendars.
Best,
Josh
